description: Add optional currentHtml 'revision' support to the AI layer so an existing HTML document can be edited in place instead of regenerated from scratch. Extend src/lib/ai.ts generateHtmlWithAi and thread the field through the /api/generate-content route. Fully backward compatible: no currentHtml = today's from-scratch behavior. This feature is independent of the UI features but MUST land first because FEAT-002 and FEAT-003 call the revised signature.
steps: In src/lib/ai.ts, add `currentHtml?: string` to the generateHtmlWithAi destructured params and its TypeScript param type (alongside prompt, images, kind). Do NOT change AiImage or the DashScope request shape (endpoint ${baseUrl}/chat/completions, bearer DASHSCOPE_API_KEY, model DEEPSEEK_MODEL/default deepseek-v4.1-flash, messages:[{role:system},{role:user,content:[{type:text},{type:image_url,...}]}], markdown-fence stripping, exact-error surfacing).

In src/lib/ai.ts, when currentHtml is present and non-empty, select/append a REVISION directive. Keep the existing LANDING_SYSTEM_INSTRUCTION / EMAIL_SYSTEM_INSTRUCTION safety wording unchanged (educational/authorized simulation, no external resources, no credential storage, no disclaimers, email table layout). Add a revision directive that says to apply the requested changes to the provided HTML and return the COMPLETE revised HTML document, preserving everything not mentioned, returning ONLY raw HTML. For kind==='email' the revision directive MUST restate: the primary call-to-action link href must remain exactly {{link}} (literal, unencoded).

In src/app/api/generate-content/route.ts, read `const currentHtml = (formData.get('currentHtml') as string | null)?.trim() || undefined` and pass it into generateHtmlWithAi({ prompt, images, kind, currentHtml }). Keep the existing 'Add a comment or at least one file' guard, the image/video mime validation, the 20MB MAX_TOTAL_BYTES cap, the video-skip (only image/* forwarded), the 401 auth gate, the DASHSCOPE_API_KEY 'not configured' branch, and the exact-error surfacing all unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: `npm run build` passes with no type errors; generateHtmlWithAi accepts an optional currentHtml and all existing callers still compile.
With currentHtml absent, ai.ts produces the identical request body it does today (from-scratch path unchanged).
With currentHtml present and kind==='email', the composed system+user content instructs a complete revised document and still mandates the literal {{link}} CTA href.
The route reads currentHtml from multipart formData and forwards it; auth/mime/size/video-skip/error behavior is byte-for-byte unchanged.
verification: Run `npm run lint && npm run build` and confirm both pass clean.
Read back src/lib/ai.ts and route.ts to confirm the DashScope request shape and all validation branches are unchanged aside from the additive currentHtml handling.
Record as 'needs runtime verification' in findings: POST FormData with currentHtml returns a revised full HTML string; POST without it behaves as before (requires DASHSCOPE_API_KEY, live endpoint).
findings:
DONE. `npm run lint && npm run build` both pass clean.

FOR FEAT-002 / FEAT-003 (UI callers):
- Revised signature: generateHtmlWithAi({ prompt, images?, kind?, currentHtml? }). Exact new param name is `currentHtml` (camelCase), typed `currentHtml?: string`. Fully backward compatible: omit it or pass empty/whitespace-only string = today's from-scratch behavior (byte-for-byte identical request body).
- Revision is triggered only when currentHtml is a non-empty-after-trim string (isRevision = typeof currentHtml === 'string' && currentHtml.trim().length > 0).
- Route /api/generate-content reads currentHtml from multipart FormData: `const currentHtml = (formData.get('currentHtml') as string | null)?.trim() || undefined`. So the client must append a FormData field literally named `currentHtml` (the current editor HTML) alongside the existing `prompt`, `kind` ('email'|'landing'), and `files` fields. Empty/omitted field => from-scratch.
- On revision, the user text part is composed as: `${prompt}\n\nHere is the current HTML document to revise. Return the complete revised document:\n\n${currentHtml}`. Images still append as image_url parts after the text part.
- A kind-specific REVISION directive is appended to the system instruction (LANDING_REVISION_DIRECTIVE / EMAIL_REVISION_DIRECTIVE). Base safety wording (educational/authorized, no external resources, no credential storage, no disclaimers, email table layout) is unchanged. The email revision directive restates the literal {{link}} CTA href requirement.
- API still returns { html } JSON on success; errors surfaced verbatim as before; DASHSCOPE_API_KEY-missing still maps to the friendly 'not configured' 500.

NEEDS RUNTIME VERIFICATION (not run here; requires DASHSCOPE_API_KEY + live DashScope endpoint): POST FormData with a non-empty currentHtml returns a complete revised HTML string; POST without currentHtml behaves exactly as before.
